title: Free Night Awards Season Note: Night Price of a Replacement Award by Season
content:
When a member applies a replacement among the Free Night Awards to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, the season recorded on the reservation moves the replacement's night price: a peak night costs one season step more than the standard-season price, an off-peak night one season step less, and a standard night the standard-season price itself. A category's season step is the gap between its neighbouring seasons on the Ashbury Rewards award chart.

The season and category are the award season and award category recorded on the Room Reservations record of the reservation the replacement pays.

| Award categories | Season step (points) |
|---|---|
| 1 to 3 | 2500 |
| 4 to 6 | 5000 |
| 7 | 10000 |
| 8 | 15000 |

- **Peak:** the standard-season price of the category plus one season step; for a category 7 hotel, plus 10000 points.
- **Standard:** the standard-season price of the category itself.
- **Off-peak:** the standard-season price of the category less one season step; for a category 2 hotel, less 2500 points.
